# inLUMEN 1.0 Beta 3 — Reproducible prototype

Draft release notes. Do not publish until issue #129 is reconciled against the
accepted commit and final CI is green.

Beta 3 provides a verified evaluation path from a saved pipeline to reviewed
Python code, native Dagster execution, and downloadable results. It also adds
workspace isolation and documents the boundaries of recovery and data portability.

## Highlights

- Follow the supplied-code order-summary example without an LLM key: import,
  attach files, save/reopen, run, and verify 3 orders totaling 49.75.
- Start the development frontend on the supported Node 22 runtime with locked
  dependencies. Generation requests now respect the codegen repair-attempt limit.
- Keep authenticated users' saved graphs, attachments, job histories and downloads
  in separate workspaces backed by PostgreSQL, Neo4j and MinIO.
- Save immutable reusable pipelines and inspect them read-only. Reuse is limited
  to one level; nested reusable pipelines are unavailable.
- Preserve run results through the verified gateway and runner restart cases,
  and download the exact tested Dagster snapshot.

## Installation and supported evaluation environment

This is a source-distributed, **fresh-install-only prerelease**. No in-place
Beta 2 upgrade is certified. Read [compatibility and preservation](../../docs/operations/beta3-compatibility.md)
before using existing data. Use the [copyable quickstart](../../docs/prototype-quickstart.md)
and its committed example files. The source tag is `v1.0.0-beta.3` once published;
until then use the exact candidate commit recorded in the acceptance checklist.

The live local evaluation used macOS ARM64, Docker Desktop/Engine 29.7.2,
Compose 5.5.0, Node 22.23.2 and Dagster 1.13.12. Its Docker VM had 12 CPUs and
approximately 7.75 GiB RAM. These are observed test resources, not minimum
requirements or a capacity guarantee. Linux CI checks are separate from this
live walkthrough. Initial builds require Internet access and a running Docker
daemon. No prebuilt application images or binaries are supplied by this release.

Local `AUTH_ENABLED=false` shares one workspace. For multiple users, follow the
[Keycloak deployment guide](../../docs/production-multi-user.md). The disposable
two-user check used real Keycloak on local HTTP; it does not certify a fresh
production TLS/Cloudflare deployment on the final candidate.

## Safety and known limitations

- Review generated code and dependencies before execution, especially network,
  filesystem and external-service behavior. Model output is not trusted code.
- The codegen service controls Docker through its socket and is privileged
  infrastructure. Keep it private and use a controlled evaluation host. Resource
  limits on generated workers do not make the Docker control plane unprivileged.
- Dagster is the native execution engine. Argo is export-only; inLUMEN does not
  submit or observe Argo workflows. Native resource profiles are CPU-based;
  GPU execution remains an external deployment concern.
- Design JSON does not contain attached file bytes or credentials. Runtime ZIPs
  are not complete editor backups. Reattach files, re-enter credentials and
  reconstruct reusable references when moving to a fresh installation.
- Restore evidence covers representative application data at the same revision
  while retaining Keycloak identity and the encryption key. It does not cover
  Beta 2 migration, loss of the identity provider, whole-host recovery, populated
  model caches, or all service-crash combinations.
- One live LLM example and two small user fixtures are not model-quality or load
  benchmarks. No concurrency, latency, GPU or cost-capacity guarantee is made.
- Nested reusable pipelines are unsupported. Broader package round trips and
  guided tutorials remain follow-up work.

## Versions, license and reporting

The repository tag is the product version. The frontend package's `0.0.0` and
codegen/runner package and API `0.1.0` values are internal component metadata,
not Beta release identifiers. Artifact schema versions remain independent:
`inlumen.deployment-bundle@2`, `inlumen.run-spec@3`,
`inlumen.artifact-contract@3`, and `inlumen.run-result@1`.

Source is provided under the repository [Apache-2.0 license](../../LICENSE).
Dependencies and container base images retain their own licenses.

Report ordinary bugs in [GitHub issues](https://github.com/DATAPACT/inLUMEN/issues),
including the source SHA/tag, OS/architecture, Docker/Compose versions, topology,
reproduction steps and redacted logs. Never include credentials or private inputs.
Report suspected vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub private reporting](https://github.com/DATAPACT/inLUMEN/security/advisories/new).
See the [security policy](../../SECURITY.md). Do not post sensitive vulnerability
details to public issues.
